port.description: The TCP port to listen on for incoming connections.

localhost.description: The local IP address to bind to.

foreign_host.description: Remote host address. Used when faucet acts as a client or proxy.

foreign_port.description: Remote port address. Used when faucet acts as a client or proxy.

backlog.description: Maximum length of the queue of pending connections.

daemon.description: Run the process in the background.

pidfile.description: Path to the file where the process ID will be stored.

command.description: The command to execute when a connection is accepted.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command. Items should be strings.
